canonical_project: Blackstone / QTS Westfalen Data Center Campus near Hamm-Uentrop and Lippetal
owner: Blackstone / Quality Technology Services (QTS) with Industriegebiet Westfalen GmbH
notes: City of Hamm says a conditional purchase agreement enables development of a campus a few hundred meters from the Hamm-Uentrop A2 junction on Lippetal territory, with 200 MW planned IT computing power. Cross-boundary industrial-area project is relevant to Hamm division.
